name: Review
description: Review company trips before final confirmation, make allowed changes, confirm trips, cancel trips when permitted, and handle route changes such as Add Stop.

tasks.title: Review a trip before confirmation
tasks.summary: Open the trip and verify passenger, route, date, time, service, and price information before confirming.
steps: Confirm only after the information is correct.

tasks.title: Edit a trip in Review
tasks.summary: Use the Review edit action for changes that are still allowed before confirmation.
steps: Review the trip again before confirmation.

tasks.title: Confirm a trip
tasks.summary: Confirm the trip after the final review is complete.
steps: Verify route, date, time, service, and price.
Verify the trip leaves the review workflow as expected.

tasks.title: Cancel a trip
tasks.summary: Use Cancel only when the trip is eligible for cancellation under the active service rules.
steps: Read any cancellation warning or fee information.
Confirm the cancellation only when correct.

tasks.title: Add a stop to an existing trip
tasks.summary: Use the Add Stop workflow when the service allows route changes.
steps: Verify the route and updated price before confirmation.
keywords: add a stop to an existing trip

tasks.title: Review Shared trips
tasks.summary: Shared trips may contain multiple passengers; verify the passenger group and route before confirmation.
steps: Check pickup/dropoff order and Shared route details.
Confirm only after the group is correct.
